voice.serverReadonlyNote: The TTS server URL is read-only — it is defined in the .env file (TTS_BASE_URL) and requires a server restart to change.
voice.serverUrlDesc: HTTP endpoint of the external XTTS service that synthesizes WAV files from translated text and an English reference clip.
voice.sectionConcurrencyDesc: Max simultaneous POST /v1/synthesize calls per model backend. Applies immediately to new voice jobs without a server restart.
voice.xttsMaxParallelDesc: Concurrent synthesis requests when the active backend is XTTS v2 (1–32).
voice.fishSpeechMaxParallelDesc: Concurrent synthesis requests when the active backend is Fish Speech (1–32).
voice.sectionReferenceDesc: XTTS clones timbre and delivery from a short English WAV clip. These settings control which clip is sent with each synthesis request.
voice.lineReference: Use the same line as reference
voice.lineReferenceDesc: On: each line uses its own original English audio — best when every line has distinct delivery. Off: one shared clip per NPC (auto-picked, manually set in the voice editor, or Sound/Voice/.../_reference.wav) — more consistent character voice, but less line-specific nuance.
voice.sectionSynthesisDesc: Model and hyperparameters sent to POST /v1/synthesize. They affect pacing, stability, and length of generated speech. Changes apply to the next voice generation job.
voice.backendXttsDesc: Coqui XTTS v2 — use the fine-tuned Ukrainian checkpoint configured on the TTS server (xtts.use_finetuned: true).
voice.backendFishSpeechDesc: Fish Speech s2-pro — often higher quality with speaker_text; ignores XTTS-only params (speed, length penalty, top-k, text splitting).
voice.speedDesc: Playback tempo multiplier. 1.0 = model default. Try 1.1–1.15 if lines sound sluggish; lower toward 0.9 if speech feels rushed.
voice.lengthPenaltyDesc: Penalizes long outputs — the main knob for drawn-out delivery on short game lines. Raise (e.g. 1.2–2.0) to shorten utterances; lower if lines get cut off too early.
voice.temperatureDesc: Randomness of speech generation. Lower (≈0.5–0.65) = steadier, more predictable takes; higher = more variation between regenerations.
voice.repetitionPenaltyDesc: Suppresses repeated syllables, stutters, and loops. Increase (e.g. 2.0–3.0) when you hear echoing; decrease if pronunciation becomes unnatural.
voice.topPDesc: Nucleus sampling: only tokens within the top cumulative probability mass are considered. Typical range 0.8–0.9. Lower = safer, less expressive.
voice.topKDesc: Limits sampling to the K most likely tokens at each step. Default 50 is a good balance; lower values can sound more monotone.
voice.textSplittingDesc: When enabled, XTTS may break long translations into several utterances. Keep off for short dialogue lines so each string stays one continuous clip.

workflow.autoApproveDesc: When enabled, manually saved translations skip Draft status and go directly to Reviewed.
workflow.propagateDesc: When a string is saved, automatically propagate the translation to untranslated strings with identical source text.
workflow.hideIgnoredDesc: When enabled, strings marked as ignored are hidden in the editor by default.
workflow.endPunctMatchDesc: Flag a QA warning when the translation ends with different punctuation than the source (.  !  ?  …).
workflow.minWordCountDesc: Minimum number of words required in a translation (0 = disabled, 1 = default).
workflow.skipTes4Desc: Exclude TES4 header records during ESP/ESM file import.
workflow.ragEnabledDesc: Retrieve similar reviewed translations and pass them as few-shot examples to the LLM.
workflow.ragMaxExamplesDesc: How many similar translations to include per string (1–10).
workflow.ragMinSimilarityDesc: Minimum cosine similarity for embedding-based retrieval (0–1). TM matches ignore this threshold.
